'''Reevos''' were [[Amphibian/Legends|amphibians]] creatures native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cholganna/Legends|Cholganna]]. Each had a prominent, lizard-like head on a long, upright neck around 3 meters tall. Reevos also had a water-cannon-like ability to knock down prey.
